parameters.query:
-- Verhaeltnis zwischen gemeldetem Bruttobetrag und eigener Nettorechnung.
-- Keine Annahme ueber den Steuersatz. Zwei Formeln werden gegenuebergestellt:
--   netto_mal_menge  = summe(amount_net * quantity)
--   netto_ohne_menge = summe(amount_net)
WITH je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id,
        b.is_b2b,
        (SELECT round(sum(p.amount_net * p.quantity), 2)
           FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
          WHERE p.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS netto_mal_menge,
        (SELECT round(sum(p.amount_net), 2)
           FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
          WHERE p.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS netto_ohne_menge,
        (SELECT round(sum(t.amount), 2)
           FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
          WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS brutto_gemeldet
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    WHERE b.is_deleted = false
),
bewertet AS (
    SELECT
        is_b2b,
        CASE WHEN netto_mal_menge  > 0 THEN round(brutto_gemeldet / netto_mal_menge,  3) END AS faktor_mit_menge,
        CASE WHEN netto_ohne_menge > 0 THEN round(brutto_gemeldet / netto_ohne_menge, 3) END AS faktor_ohne_menge
    FROM je_buchung
    WHERE brutto_gemeldet > 0
      AND netto_mal_menge > 0
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_b2b THEN 'B2B' ELSE 'nicht B2B' END       AS gruppe,
    faktor_mit_menge                                        AS faktor_mit_menge,
    faktor_ohne_menge                                       AS faktor_ohne_menge,
    count(*)                                                AS buchungen
FROM bewertet
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY buchungen DESC
LIMIT 40;

-- Buchungen mit mehr als einem Platz. Liegt der Faktor bei einer
-- ganzen Zahl nahe der Menge, waere amount_net bereits die Zeilensumme.
SELECT
    right(b.booking_id, 12)              AS buchung_kurz,
    b.is_b2b,
    b.status,
    p.pricecategory_name                 AS preiskategorie,
    p.quantity                           AS menge,
    p.amount_net                         AS preis_netto,
    round(p.amount_net * p.quantity, 2)  AS netto_mal_menge,
    (SELECT round(sum(t.amount), 2)
       FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
      WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS brutto_gemeldet
FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_position p ON p.booking_id = b.booking_id
WHERE b.is_deleted = false
  AND p.quantity > 1
  AND p.amount_net > 0
ORDER BY p.quantity DESC, p.amount_net DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Zwoelf moeglichst unterschiedliche Buchungen als Probe.
(SELECT booking_id FROM edoobox_raw.booking
  WHERE is_deleted = false AND is_b2b = true
  ORDER BY booking_time DESC LIMIT 6)
UNION ALL
(SELECT booking_id FROM edoobox_raw.booking
  WHERE is_deleted = false AND coalesce(is_b2b, false) = false
  ORDER BY booking_time DESC LIMIT 6);
